name: Manus Cloud Computer
desc: Purchasable always-on environment for projects that outgrow a laptop.
desc_zh: 为超出单机能力的项目购买的常驻运行环境
solves: A multiplayer game needs a server that stays up when the laptop closes, and an automation needs somewhere to run around the clock. Cloud Computer is that dedicated environment.
solves_zh: 多人游戏需要一台在笔记本合上后仍在运行的服务器，自动化也需要一个全天候的落脚处。Cloud Computer 就是这个专用环境。
best_for: Your project has to keep running overnight and nobody wants to leave a machine on.
best_for_zh: 你的项目必须通宵运行，而没人想为此让一台机器一直开着。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://manus.im/blog , then the Manus product menu）。 Announced 2026-09-28 with Manus 2.0 and sold as a purchase rather than a plan feature. Missing from the ledger, which holds Manus (2025-03-06) and Monica (2023-10-01) for this vendor. The same post also introduced Manus Studio, the Cascade agent framework and the Cue app. No media source was read. 评审修正（2026-11-25）：原地址是博客文章，不是稳定的产品入口页；Manus 官网即是入口。 首次公开日期来源：https://manus.im/blog/introducing-manus-2-0
